reason: Both one-attempt primary outputs passed schema and complete-reading authentication but mechanically reused one argument-level explanation across all six criterion ratings for every one of 30 moves. Neither output is accepted.
requirements: Freeze a new authorization and execution plan before any replacement dispatch; the quotation-only approval is insufficient.
Use fresh contexts with no inherited conversation, no rejected judgments, no other reviewers, no publication, no legacy assessment, no scores and no winners.
Every context reads the complete frozen scoped source, inventory and required controls; authenticate reading before releasing its assigned judgment task.
Each section context writes only that section's move judgments and source reviews. Each burden context writes only both whole-debate burden-completion judgments. Outputs use separate new paths.
Require substantive criterion-specific reasoning for each of the six dimensions; criterion-name substitutions and paraphrased repetition do not qualify.
Preserve one final submission per context, validate schema and semantic reasoning before acceptance, and reject rather than automatically retry an exhausted replacement.
Assemble complete primary passes deterministically without changing the independently supplied ratings or reasons. Never reuse the rejected ratings or calculate totals during assembly.
Keep the accepted inventory, source evidence, moderator exclusion, model, scoring controls and completed paid-call evidence unchanged. Resolve any new source concern before adjudication.
No further paid transcription is proposed or authorized by this replacement plan.
